summary: Iteration 45 — Retest of iter44 bug fixes. All 4 frontend scenarios PASS: (1) all 5 role-toggle checkboxes (manager, sales, stock_keeper, community_manager, rider) are CHECKED on load at /console/parametres?tab=pointage; (2) topbar-punch is visible initially on /console, then DISAPPEARS after admin toggles attendance-enabled OFF and clicks pointage-save (window event 'attendance-config-changed' propagates to ConsoleLayout which refetches /api/business); (3) toggling attendance-enabled back ON, saving, and navigating to /console shows topbar-punch again; (4) rider1 login shows rider-punch-btn. Backend regression (test_iter44_attendance_stats.py) 13/13 PASS — GET /api/attendance/all-stats admin+manager OK / sales+cm 403, PATCH /api/business/attendance-config admin-only + persist, check-in without GPS still 200/409. Final backend state restored to {enabled:true, enabled_roles:[manager,sales,stock_keeper,community_manager,rider]} as requested for next iteration.

issues: Pre-existing non-blocking React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' originating from a SearchSelect/select component referenced from ConsoleLayout tree. Not introduced in iter45, carried from iter44.

action_items: (Optional/non-blocking) Fix the <span> inside <option> hydration warning on login page — likely in a shadcn Select/SearchSelect component rendering option content inside a native <option>.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix verified in ConsoleLayout.jsx (lines 142-155): useEffect fetching /api/business is now re-run on pathname change AND listens to 'attendance-config-changed' window event. punchAllowed correctly short-circuits on attendanceCfg.enabled !== false regardless of role (including admin).
Fix verified in Settings.jsx PointageTab (lines 452-464): save() dispatches window Event('attendance-config-changed') after PATCH, so both ConsoleLayout and RiderShell refetch config immediately.

Fix verified in RiderShell.jsx (lines 37-47): adds the same event listener; however RiderShell's main effect has empty dep array (not pathname-based) — fine since riders don't navigate to settings. OK.
Role toggle hydration bug (iter44) was also fixed — all 5 role toggles now reflect backend enabled_roles correctly.
seed_data_creation: None. Backend attendance_config left in clean state (enabled=true, all 5 roles enabled) for next iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter45 fixes fully verified. attendance_config state at end of run: {enabled:true, enabled_roles:[manager,sales,stock_keeper,community_manager,rider]}. The 'attendance-config-changed' window event pattern works well — if adding more consumers (new shells/dashboards), subscribe them to this event + /api/business GET for consistent cross-tab/cross-view sync.
rca_of_the_issue: iter44 Bug 1 (topbar-punch not hiding) and Bug 2 (role toggles unchecked) both resolved. Fix pattern: (a) Settings PointageTab now initializes enabled_roles from attendance_config.enabled_roles with matching backend keys (rider, stock_keeper) and falls back to full list; (b) After save, dispatches window event; (c) ConsoleLayout/RiderShell subscribe to event and refetch /business, re-computing punchAllowed. End-to-end confirmed.
